title: 60 Hal jaza'u l-ihsani illa lihsan. StormOfBlood
body:
Sura 56 Al-Waqiah

1 When the event befalls. NewsOfShaban

Sura 57 Al-Hadeed

13 One day will the hypocrites, men and women, say to the believers, "Wait for us! Let us borrow (a light) from your light!" It
will be said, "Turn ye back to your rear! Then seek a light (where ye can)!" So a wall will be put up between them, with a gate
therein. Within it will be mercy throughout, and without it, all alongside, will be (wrath and) punishment!

ReturnAndSeekTheLight

27 But the Monasticism which they invented for themselves, We did not prescribe for them. (We commanded) only the
seeking for the good pleasure of Allah, but they did not foster that as they should have done. BlessingsOfSham

Sura 58 Al-Mujadila

19 Fa'ansahum Dhikra Al-Lahi. (Satan has overcome them and made) them forget the remembrance of Allah. Nero

Sura 59 Al-Hashr

2 But the (Wrath of) Allah came to them from quarters from which they little expected (it), and cast terror into their hearts, so
that they destroyed their dwellings by their own hands and the hands of the Believers... NeverendingBattery

RijaalAllah SignsOfDivineAnger SovereigntyIsForWhom

7 Leave what Prophet (s) forbade and take what he ordered. WayOfHonor
10 Rabbana Aghfir Lana Wa Li'akhwanina Al-Ladhina Sabaquna Bil-'Imani Wa La Taj`al Fi Qulubina Ghillaan Lilladhina
'Amanu Rabbana 'Innaka Ra'ufun Rahimun. BeSmallServants
